mapper.select: SELECT count(*)::integer AS total_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE record.status = 'PRESENT')::integer AS present_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE record.status = 'LATE')::integer AS late_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE record.status = 'ABSENT')::integer AS absent_count FROM public.attendance_target AS target JOIN public.attendance_day AS day ON day.id = target.attendance_day_id AND day.department_id = target.department_id AND day.status = 'FINALIZED' LEFT JOIN public.attendance_record AS record ON record.attendance_day_id = target.attendance_day_id AND record.member_id = target.member_id WHERE target.department_id = #{departmentId} AND target.member_id = #{memberId} AND target.is_target AND day.attendance_date BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate}

SELECT record.band_sequence_snapshot AS sequence_no, record.band_label_snapshot AS label, count(*)::integer AS count FROM public.attendance_target AS target JOIN public.attendance_day AS day ON day.id = target.attendance_day_id AND day.department_id = target.department_id AND day.status = 'FINALIZED' JOIN public.attendance_record AS record ON record.attendance_day_id = target.attendance_day_id AND record.member_id = target.member_id AND record.status = 'LATE' WHERE target.department_id = #{departmentId} AND target.member_id = #{memberId} AND target.is_target AND day.attendance_date BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} GROUP BY record.band_sequence_snapshot, record.band_label_snapshot ORDER BY record.band_sequence_snapshot, record.band_label_snapshot
